description: Removes the two Ant <rmic> pregeneration steps from build.xml. The rmic tool they drive was removed in JDK 15, and Ant refuses the task on JDK 15+, which is the only thing stopping the JADE build on JDK 17. Agent-mode recipe: the shard contract names the file; this document defines the transform and the one condition under which the agent must stop instead.
